page_title: PAR 2-2 TOR | Parma v Torino 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
90+4' Yann Karamoh (Torino) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. There is a free kick near the sideline to Parma.
90+2' Karol Linetty (Torino) commits a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for an infringement. Parma win a free kick.
90+1' Dennis Man (Parma) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
90+1' That's the end of the game for Samuele Ricci, who is replaced by Karol Linetty (Torino).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Dennis Man (Parma) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
88' Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul after Marcus Pedersen (Torino) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Parma in a dangerous position.
88' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
86' A corner kick by Parma is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino).
84' Valentino Lazaro comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Torino).
84' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle. Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Torino.
82' 2 - 2 Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) scores from the resulting corner! He rises highest and plants a powerful header beyond the goalkeeper into the roof of the net.
82' Hernani (Parma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
82' The resulting set piece from Parma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Parma can continue in their attacking effort.
81' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma). Torino have a free kick.
80' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
79' Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Torino have been awarded a free kick.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
76' Substitution. Pontus Almqvist did his best and is replaced by Dennis Man (Parma).
75' Torino fail to score from a corner as Zion Suzuki (Parma) leaps to collect the ball.
74' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Gvidas Gineitis (Torino). The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.
73' The booking goes to Che Adams (Torino).
72' 1 - 2 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Guillermo Maripan finds Che Adams (Torino) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball inside the left post. 1:2.
71' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) gets a yellow card.
69' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Yann Karamoh (Torino) replaces Eljif Elmas.
69' Here comes a substitution. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Cesare Casadei.
69' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle as Emanuele Valeri (Parma) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. A free kick has been awarded to Torino.
68' The game has come to an end for Simon Sohm. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Hernani (Parma).
68' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Pontus Almqvist (Parma) but poses no threat.
67' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
66' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.
64' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Torino are awarded the free kick.
60' 1 - 1 Goal! Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) takes a short pass from Emanuele Valeri in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
57' Booking. Simon Sohm (Parma) receives a caution from the referee.
55' Christian Chivu has decided to substitute Nahuel Estevez and he is replaced by Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma).
55' Substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma).
55' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lautaro Valenti walks off the pitch to be replaced by Giovanni Leoni (Parma).
55' A corner kick by Parma is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino).
54' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Corner kick. Parma will have an opportunity.
54' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
52' A poor mid-range free-kick by Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
51' Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight and sees a foul from Eljif Elmas (Torino). Parma are awarded a free kick.

50' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
49' Francesco Fourneau interrupts the game. One of the players from Torino won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Parma will take a free kick.
48' A fine solo run by Pontus Almqvist (Parma) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Francesco Fourneau has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Eljif Elmas (Torino) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) rises above the defence and powers a header at the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a superb save.
45' Now Parma have a corner.
44' A cross from Nahuel Estevez (Parma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Parma will take a corner.
44' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) makes a strong challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul. Free kick. Parma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

40' Ambitious effort from Mandela Keita (Parma). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
40' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
39' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick is awarded to Parma.

37' A player from Parma commits a rough challenge. Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Torino win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
36' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Torino have a free kick.
35' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
35' Today's referee Francesco Fourneau rightly decides to book Lautaro Valenti (Parma) for his harsh tackle.
35' An attempted cross from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is cleared.

35' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
33' Eljif Elmas (Torino) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
32' Eljif Elmas (Torino) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
32' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

29' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Torino, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
27' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
25' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Samuele Ricci (Torino) for a tough tackle.
24' Mandela Keita (Parma) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Torino are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
23' Mandela Keita (Parma) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for an infringement. Torino get a free kick.
19' 0 - 1 Goal! Cesare Casadei provides Eljif Elmas (Torino) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 0:1.

18' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner kick and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
18' The referee awards a corner and Nahuel Estevez (Parma) goes over to take it.
17' A lofted cross from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Parma are awarded a corner kick.
16' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

15' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort. Good work from Torino as they win a corner.
13' The foul by Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Francesco Fourneau.
13' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
12' The referee blows his whistle as Valentino Lazaro (Torino) was too aggressive in his challenge. Parma will take a free kick near the side line.
11' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
11' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
10' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
6' Dangerous play by Nahuel Estevez (Parma). Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Torino, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
5' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
4' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
3' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
3' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
2' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee signals a corner kick to Torino.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Torino will kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau was nominated as the referee for this game.
